description: START HERE if you do not yet know what this server can do. Returns the complete capability inventory: every HTTP endpoint with its purpose, when to use it and what to call next; every MCP tool name; the recommended multi-step research workflows (including how to build a worldwide disease-cure trial landscape honestly); and the URLs of the machine-readable contracts (OpenAPI, agent card, AI plugin manifest, TypeScript SDK, provenance and contract-integrity endpoints). Takes no arguments. Call this before guessing an endpoint or a parameter name.
name: list_capabilities
